column2: On the authority of Abū Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him), who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Allah the Exalted said: “Whoever is hostile to an ally of Mine, I have declared war against him. My servant does not draw near to Me with anything more beloved to Me than what I have made obligatory on him,

and My servant continues to draw near to Me with voluntary deeds until I love him. When I love him, I become his hearing with which he hears, his sight with which he sees, his hand with which he strikes,
and his foot with which he walks. If he asks Me, I will surely give him;
and if he seeks refuge with Me, I will surely grant him refuge.” Reported by al-Bukhārī.
ʿĀdā lī (“is hostile [to an ally] of Mine”): from muʿādāh (hostility), the opposite of muwālāh (alliance).

Waliyyan (“an ally”): one who keeps constantly to obeying Allah, making his worship sincerely for Allah. “I have declared war against him”: I inform him that I am at war with him. ʿAbdī (“My servant”): the attribution is for honour.

Iftaraḍtuhu (“I have made obligatory”): I have made binding. Yataqarrabu ilayya (“draws near to Me”): seeks nearness to Me. Bi-l-nawāfil (“with voluntary deeds”): voluntary acts. La-uʿṭiyannahu (“I will surely give him”): what he asked for.
La-uʿīdhannahu (“I will surely grant him refuge”): from what he fears.
Whoever is hostile to the allies of Allah, Allah has declared war against him.
The most beloved of deeds to Allah is performing the obligations and keeping to them.
Voluntary deeds are accepted when the obligations have been performed, and doing many voluntary deeds is a cause of Allah's love.
The allies of Allah are those who draw near to Allah with righteous deeds.

Whoever does what is obligatory on him and draws near to Allah with voluntary deeds, Allah grants him success in every good, so that his deeds, movements and stillness proceed according to what the Sharīʿah requires.
Whoever reaches this station has his supplication answered.
However much a person attains in worship, he does not stop asking his Lord.

In this hadith the Prophet ﷺ tells us that Allah, Glorified and Exalted is He, said: “Whoever is hostile to an ally of Mine, I have declared war against him”, that is, whoever is an enemy to My allies, let him know that I am at war with him, since by being hostile to My allies he is at war with Me;

that the most beloved thing a servant can do for Allah, Majestic and Exalted is He, is to carry out what Allah has made obligatory on him of the five prayers and other things; and that whoever combines carrying out the obligations

with drawing near to Allah through voluntary deeds, Allah loves him; and among the effects of His love for him is that He guards his hearing, his sight, the striking of his hand and the walking of his foot from the devil's leading him astray, so that he stretches his limbs towards sins and his heart towards loving them.
Be a brother and a close friend to the righteous, / and be in this world a stranger.
